name: Rep-Tile Inflation
desc: The chair rep-tile inflating and deflating without end — every L-tromino splits into four half-size copies of itself, the substitution depth breathing so the pavement resolves into finer and finer generations and merges back while the whole plane drifts.

energy.doc: how far the substitution depth swings each cycle (at max it runs from one generation to four and back)

tilt.doc: how much the plane rotates off axis-aligned (0 = a strict orthogonal pavement)

x.doc: lattice origin x as canvas fraction

y.doc: lattice origin y as canvas fraction

style.doc: aesthetic: poured concrete in four castings / glossy lacquer panels / cyan setting-out plan (line only) / hatched engraved plate / pure abstraction — tiles coloured by their position in the substitution tree, so the inflation hierarchy itself becomes the image

seed.doc: deterministic seed — picks which of the two exact seedings each 3x2 cell takes
